description:
foobar2000 is an advanced freeware audio player for the Windows platform.


- Converter changes
  - New preset format, presets stored as .ini files in profile subfolder. Old presets imported on first run.
  - Better error messages when receiving unexpected data format change in mid-conversion; made discard blank chunks before checking for format match.
  - Added extensible post-conversion actions which can be used for ReplayGain scanning, integrity testing, etc.
  - On conversion error, encoder's stderr output is forwarded to foobar2000 console.
  - Ogg chaining is now off by default, Ogg chapters written by default instead.
  - Added %source_list_index% & %source_list_total%, only for multi track image naming pattern use, to allow use of list indexes in the pattern.
  - Made file name preview recognize newly added %source_list_index%.
  - Made show output of command-line encoder program in error popup if conversion has failed.
  - Made "no DSP reset" explicitly shown in overview, as it's dangerous if enabled unintentionally.
- ReplayGain Scanner changes
  - Added new interface for components to access ReplayGain scanning options.
  - Added option to write REPLAYGAIN_ALGORITHM tag.
  - Default mode is now more accurately named "ITU-R BS.1770".
- Resampler technology updates
  - New resamplers: ARDFTSRC and Speex, replacing SSRC and libretro from previous versions. New resamplers provide better quality at comparable speeds / better speeds at comparable quality.
  - Cleaned up resampler settings, removed pointless "exclude rates" checkboxes, added explicit hints about formatting.
  - Made resampler priority setting accept short names of resamplers, e.g. "speex;ardftsrc".
- Playback & file format handling changes
  - Added support for decoding TrueHD & MLP streams in Matroska.
  - New info field: container (MP4, Matroska, Ogg, etc)
  - Improved handling of Matroska Segment Title field.
  - Improved recovery of malformed UTF-8 text in various tag formats.
  - Made print name of file format handler used to console, after "opening track for playback".
  - More accurate on_playback_dynamic_info() timing, restored correct operation of OpenMPT visualizations.
  - Added advanced preferences toggle to turn off all subsong support, forcibly present 1 file as 1 playlist entry.
  - Faster opening of Matroska files.
  - Monkey's Audio format is now handled via FFmpeg.
- MP4/M4A/M4B improvements
  - Tagtype info (Apple, Nero)
  - No longer writes Nero tags by default for single chapter files, only for multi chapter where other tagging formats can't store per track tags.
  - Added support for some rarely used Apple tag elements.
  - No longer alters binary structure of Apple tag elements which are not affected by edits.
  - More robust handling of unusual Apple tag fields.
- General usability changes
  - New title formatting field: %_cpu_arch%
  - Added drag&drop from Internet Radio pages to playlist.
  - Attempt to play a password-protected resource such as radio stream now shows a password prompt.
  - Equalizer now accepts presets via drag&drop from Explorer/Finder.
  - Added "Play on" feature from foobar2000 mobile - accessible from playlist & internet radio context menu .
  - Made playlist sort operations recognize %queue_index% and other playlist specific fields.
  - Added "Playback Information" section to View menu, meant for components.
  - Made "Verify with AccurateRip" command available if your tracknumbers don't strictly match most common numbering scheme.
  - Added Help / Search Query Syntax.
  - Smarter "remove duplicates" code, made aware of various scenarios where different perceived paths point to same file.
  - Restored LargeFieldsConfig feature - https://www.foobar2000.org/LargeFieldsConfig-v2
  - Updated title formatting help with some recent and some not-really-recent additions.
  - File Operations: Made gracefully refuse to rename archive contents.
- Networking
  - Improved reading of RAR archives on network shares.
  - Improved SMB read throughput over high-latency connections.
- Windows specific changes
  - Advanced Preferences: Disabled Wine treeview workarounds if running Wine newer than 11.12.
  - Default User Interface: made render album art using Windows Imaging Component / Direct2D.
  - Enabled reading of EXIF orientation info from album cover pictures.
- Libraries updated to newer versions: FFmpeg, Opus, zlib, RAR, 7-zip, SQLite
